title: Orchestrator Startup Health Gate

evidence.evidence: Orchestrator.run invokes startup_health_gate before the signal checkpoint is persisted.
Initial corrupt runtime health raises OrchestratorError before transaction recovery.
Startup gate replays pending transactions and requires a second health inspection before accepting work.
Final degraded state is rejected; only healthy and recovered_from_backup are accepted.
